name: Hayate
subtitle: Apple Watch voice to webhook
promotionalText: Just speak to your Apple Watch and send it to Slack, Discord, or your own webhook. Send what comes to mind right from your wrist.
description:
Hayate sends what you say to your Apple Watch straight to the destination (webhook) you registered.

■ What it does
・Press “Speak” on Apple Watch and talk to send (on Series 9 / Ultra 2 or later, you can also double tap)
・Say “Hey Siri, send with Hayate” to send hands-free (Siri on iPhone works too)
・Set up destinations freely: URL, method, headers (such as Authorization), and body template
・For Slack and Discord, just paste the URL
・Sends directly from the watch, without going through iPhone
・Keeps anything that couldn’t be sent and retries the next time you open the app
・History of what you sent, test sends, and a watch face complication

■ Ways to use it
・Send notes to a Slack channel the moment you think of them
・Send shopping lists and to-dos to your own service
・Receive in n8n, Zapier, or your own server to automate

■ For the receiving side
・You can insert {{text}} (what you said), {{id}}, {{sentAt}}, and {{source}} into the body
・The X-WatchHook-Message-Id header stays the same when resent, so you can use it to remove duplicates

■ How data is handled
・Destination settings (including authentication headers) are stored only in the Keychain on iPhone and Apple Watch
・What you say is sent only to the destinations you registered. It doesn’t pass through the developer’s servers

■ Pricing
Try it free for 7 days. After that, keep using it with a one-time in-app purchase. There is no subscription.
